answer_1.quote: MAS enhances creativity by dividing the cognitive workload... across specialized agents... conversational agents can automate screenwriting...
answer_1.outputs: screenplays, research proposals, product designs, software code, stories

answer_2.quote: Objective, Metric-Based Measures use formulas such as cosine similarity and statistics methods to evaluate creativity... Distinct-n computes the proportion of unique n-grams... Entropy-n measures the Shannon entropy... Self-BLEU score... Sentence-BERT embeddings...

answer_3.quote: More recently, LLM-as-a-judge approaches have gained popularity, leveraging LLMs to assign scores on predefined scales.

answer_4.quote: Subjective, Natural Language Instructed Assessments ask experts, crowds, or LLMs to rate creativity... user studies are primarily employed here, focusing on criteria such as satisfaction... Torrance Tests of Creative Thinking (TTCT) is a common standard... scored along four primary dimensions...
answer_4.guideline: TTCT dimensions: Fluency, Flexibility, Originality, Elaboration; Creative Support Index (CSI) dimensions: Collaboration, Engagement, Expressiveness
